skill.description: Use when the user asks to "amplify influencer content with paid media", "set up whitelisting or Spark Ads", "decide which posts to boost", "repurpose influencer content", "turn one video into multiple ads", or "build a UGC asset library"; produces (paid mode) a content-selection scorecard, a paid amplification strategy (whitelisting/boosting/dark posts), audience targeting, and a budget+optimization plan, or (repurpose mode) a rights-tracked content inventory, a 1-video-to-10+-asset repurposing map, per-format transformation specs, and a 30-day distribution plan. content.value_statement: Strong creator content often remains underused after publication. This skill turns approved assets into paid-media plans, reusable formats, and tracked distribution schedules.
actual_capabilities: Scores creator posts against organic performance, hook quality, message clarity, production quality, and call-to-action strength.
Builds paid amplification plans covering whitelisting, Spark Ads, brand boosting, and dark posts.
Allocates budgets by content, objective, platform, and campaign phase.
Creates audience targeting, KPI thresholds, testing plans, and scale-or-pause rules.
Maps approved source assets into channel-specific videos, images, quotes, website placements, and email assets.
Produces rights-tracked inventories, naming conventions, asset libraries, and 30-day distribution plans.
limitations: It does not approve content for brand alignment, claim accuracy, disclosure, or regulatory compliance.
It requires user-provided metrics or optional connector data for measured performance recommendations.
It does not process audio or video files; users must provide transcripts, captions, or asset details.
It cannot recommend reuse when usage rights are unknown or limited to organic channels.

use_cases.title: Select Paid Media Winners
use_cases.description: Rank approved creator posts and allocate a campaign budget across the strongest candidates.

use_cases.title: Build a UGC Asset Library
use_cases.description: Organize creator assets with rights, expiration dates, metadata, naming rules, and channel availability.

use_cases.title: Plan Multichannel Repurposing
use_cases.description: Transform a small approved source set into paid, website, email, and organic social placements.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Content to Amplify
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these approved creator posts and rank which ones should receive our [budget] across [platforms].

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose Approved Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these [number] approved creator videos into a 30-day plan for [channels], respecting the listed usage rights.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Paid Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [budget] amplification strategy using these metrics, campaign goals, platforms, rights, and creator authorization details.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Optimization System
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop content scores, audience segments, budget pacing, tests, KPI targets, and scale-or-pause rules from this campaign dataset.

output_examples.input: Five approved TikTok videos, organic metrics, a $5,000 budget, and awareness goals.
output: Ranks all five videos with clear scoring reasons.
Allocates the full budget across selected videos and a testing reserve.
Defines Spark Ads authorization, targeting, pacing, and scaling actions.

output_examples.input: Three approved creator videos with rights details for website, email, paid media, and social.
output: Creates a rights-tracked inventory for every source asset.
Maps each video into channel-specific formats and modifications.
Schedules approved assets across a 30-day distribution calendar.

output_examples.input: A creator transcript with timestamps and recent campaign atom records.
output: Extracts reusable quotes, stories, claims, frameworks, and predictions.
Ranks each atom with the documented virality heuristic.

best_practices: Provide measured organic metrics, campaign goals, budget, target platforms, and usage rights before requesting a plan.
Label every metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated, including the basis for estimates.
Confirm creator authorization and channel rights before scheduling paid, website, or email reuse.
anti_patterns: Do not amplify weak creative because additional spend will not repair poor content.
Do not invent reach, engagement, CPM, ROAS, rights dates, or creator authorization.
Do not reuse organic-only or unknown-rights assets in paid, website, or email placements.

faq.question: What is the difference between paid and repurpose modes?
faq.answer: Paid mode plans advertising spend and optimization. Repurpose mode creates new channel assets and a distribution schedule from approved content.

faq.question: Does the skill publish ads or edit videos?
faq.answer: No. It produces plans, specifications, scorecards, and trackers for users or connected workflows to implement.

faq.question: Can it work without platform connectors?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide campaign data directly, and the skill will label missing or inferred values as estimated.

faq.question: Does it check FTC disclosures or claim accuracy?
faq.answer: No. Content must pass a separate compliance and brand review before this skill runs.

faq.question: What rights information is required?
faq.answer: Provide each asset's approved channels, paid-use status, duration, expiration date, and creator authorization status.

faq.question: How does it avoid repeated content?
faq.answer: It compares extracted content atoms with current and recent records using a documented Jaccard similarity threshold.
